title: Dev Scripts
description: Các lệnh ít dùng — chạy bằng: node scripts/run-dev-script.mjs <key>

scripts.migration:generate: cross-env NODE_ENV=development node -r tsconfig-paths/register ./node_modules/typeorm/cli-ts-node-commonjs.js -- migration:generate -d src/config/data-source.ts --verbose
scripts.migration:revert: cross-env NODE_ENV=development node -r tsconfig-paths/register ./node_modules/typeorm/cli-ts-node-commonjs.js -- migration:revert -d src/config/data-source.ts --verbose
scripts.migration:show: cross-env NODE_ENV=development node -r tsconfig-paths/register ./node_modules/typeorm/cli-ts-node-commonjs.js -- migration:show -d src/config/data-source.ts --verbose
scripts.db:outbox:reset: docker exec crypto_trading_postgres psql -U crypto_user -d crypto_trading_platform -c "UPDATE integration_outbox SET dead_lettered_at = NULL, publish_attempts = 0, next_retry_at = NULL WHERE dead_lettered_at IS NOT NULL;"
scripts.db:migrate:ch:status: docker exec crypto_trading_clickhouse clickhouse-client --host localhost --port 9000 --query "SHOW TABLES FROM analytics FORMAT PrettyCompact"
scripts.clickhouse:tables:list: docker exec crypto_trading_clickhouse clickhouse-client --host localhost --port 9000 --query "SHOW TABLES FROM analytics FORMAT PrettyCompact"
scripts.kafka:topics:create: docker compose -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml --env-file .env.development --profile kafka run --rm kafka-init
scripts.clickhouse:init:run: docker compose -f docker-compose.infrastructure.yml --env-file .env.development --profile clickhouse run --rm clickhouse-init
scripts.treasury:daily: npm run treasury:e2e && npm run treasury:health
